verdict.rationale: Warp explicitly markets itself as 'API, CLI, SDK and MCP built as a platform' (warp-docs-42) and a probe confirms a live OpenAPI spec at docs.warp.dev/openapi.json (warp-probe-2), plus a documented Oz CLI for scripting/CI automation of cloud agents (warp-docs-22, warp-docs-37, warp-docs-52). This is real evidence of a public, documented API surface for driving Warp programmatically. Missing for 10: a dedicated human-readable API reference page enumerating endpoints/auth (beyond the raw OpenAPI JSON), and independent/hands-on confirmation that developers have successfully used the API outside Warp's own docs.
